title: 26 CFR 1.263A-1, Uniform capitalization of costs (4-1-25 edition)
issuer: U.S. Government Publishing Office, Code of Federal Regulations

passages.question: Do the $143,000.00 home selling costs belong in cost of goods sold or in page 1 deductions?
passages.excerpt: The following indirect costs are not required to be capitalized under section 263A: (A) Selling and distribution costs. These costs are marketing, selling, advertising, and distribution costs.
